COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer), and a prolonged INR. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and coagulopathy. The elevated alkaline phosphatase and mild monocytosis may indicate hepatic or bone involvement. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
